templates.name: Independent 0 mV/period, 70 K candidate (adaptive_working)
templates.description: Historical independent stationary candidate at 0 mV/period and lattice/LO 70 K, with LO, acoustic, impurity, interface-roughness and alloy scattering; electron-electron mode none is a Runner/Core typed default. Uses adaptive_working and a 128 GiB recovery byte budget. This is not the exact strict active SCI4 preset and has no scientific acceptance.
